and by scripts/build.sh. It has never existed, so npm run build has never succeeded.
Extends the root so the path aliases and strictness are declared once. Note that this
project emits to dist/api, which is one of the two directories scripts/deploy.sh
consumes and scripts/build.sh has never produced. Producing it here does not make

credentials the operator happens to hold. See PR 2 in the consolidation plan.
TypeScript ignores a top level key named // in tsconfig files, so this block is legal
and may be left in place.
